You are forecasting an opponent in a repeated simultaneous binary hide-and-seek game. Each round both players choose 0 or 1 without observing the other current choice. The seeker receives +1 if choices match and -1 otherwise; the hider receives the opposite payoff. The opponent may adapt to past play. Estimate the probability that the opponent chooses 1 on the NEXT round. Use only the complete past observations below. No current choices or hidden opponent state are available. Report your predictive probability, not a sampled action.
Your role: hider
Decision round: 6

round=2; self_action=1; opponent_action=0; self_payoff=1
round=3; self_action=1; opponent_action=1; self_payoff=-1
round=4; self_action=1; opponent_action=1; self_payoff=-1
round=5; self_action=0; opponent_action=1; self_payoff=1
You are A; the opponent is B. No identity, algorithm or private state of B is known. Do not assume a specific algorithm. Also report own_action, the action (0 or 1) you would choose to maximize your expected payoff this round. Your answer will not change the recorded history. Return the requested JSON fields only.
Any previously proposed own_action is only a recommendation, not an observed action. Use the recorded past observations as the actual outcomes. Do not treat your forecasts as facts.
No earlier model forecasts or reports are supplied in this independent request.
Report assessment: a brief assessment connecting observed play, incentives and your forecast (at most three sentences, not a detailed reasoning trace). Then report p_opponent_1: your own forecast of B choosing 1 now. Finally report own_action. Keep perspectives distinct; all estimates are uncertain.
